competitors.name: Wealthsimple Gold
competitors.one_liner: The most dangerous competitor in Canada — physically-backed gold trading inside an app millions already trust.
beats_auri: Regulated brokerage, no liquidation risk to explain
auri_beats: Cannot borrow against gold — Auri's entire credit product doesn't exist there
Custodial — you trust their balance sheet, not your keys
competitors.positioning: Wealthsimple lets you own gold. Auri lets you use it. Fight on borrow/spend/send/gift/custody, never on brand or trust.
competitors.watch: Nightmare scenario: Wealthsimple adds a gold-backed line of credit. They have the balance sheet and the licence.

competitors.name: Gold ETFs (CGL / CGL.C)
competitors.one_liner: The default for any financially literate Canadian — commission-free, TFSA/RRSP-eligible paper gold.
auri_beats: You own a fund that owns gold — you can't do anything with it
competitors.positioning: You don't own gold, you own a fund that owns gold.

competitors.name: OneGold
competitors.one_liner: The strongest US incumbent — an APMEX × Sprott JV, the most credible parentage in the category.
auri_beats: OneGold is a warehouse — put gold in, take gold out, that's the whole product. Auri is an account.
competitors.positioning: OneGold is a warehouse. Auri is an account.
competitors.watch: APMEX/Sprott have the balance sheet to add a card or credit.

competitors.name: Vaulted
competitors.one_liner: Simplest US vaulted-gold app — one all-in 1.8% fee, $10 minimum (the same entry point Auri markets).
competitors.positioning: A warehouse with a low door.

competitors.name: US Gold ETFs (GLD, IAU)
competitors.one_liner: The real US volume competitor — commission-free in every brokerage, IRA/401(k)-eligible.
competitors.positioning: You don't own gold, you own a fund.

competitors.name: APMEX / JM Bullion / Costco
competitors.one_liner: Physical bullion to your door. Costco selling gold bars is the clearest signal US retail gold demand is real — these are lead sources, not competitors.
competitors.positioning: Lead source: they proved intent, Auri gives it somewhere to go.

competitors.name: Glint Pay
competitors.one_liner: The clearest precedent for spending gold — a Mastercard debit card spending gold in 210 countries.
beats_auri: Live card, years of history, spend-gold proven
competitors.positioning: Glint proves spend-gold is real. It never added credit — Auri's bet is that gap is still open.

competitors.name: Kinesis Money
competitors.one_liner: The most feature-complete gold-money platform and the most direct philosophical rival — and it pays a yield on gold.
beats_auri: Yield on gold (Auri has no equivalent — a real gap)
auri_beats: Closed proprietary system, not standard DeFi rails
competitors.positioning: Kinesis is what Auri looks like if it wins, minus credit and minus self-custody. Their yield mechanic is the best idea in the set.
competitors.watch: If Kinesis adds borrowing or self-custody.

competitors.name: Goldmoney
competitors.one_liner: Buy-and-park vaulted gold. 1.0% round trip. No spend, borrow, or yield.
competitors.positioning: Buy-and-park; makes them look old.

competitors.name: BullionVault
competitors.one_liner: Vaulted gold with a storage minimum (~$144/yr) and 2.5-10% redemption fees.
competitors.positioning: Buy-and-park with a punitive exit.

competitors.name: Ledn
competitors.one_liner: The most important competitor to watch — Tether partnered with Ledn to let XAUT holders borrow against gold. Literally Auri's core product, from the token issuer.
auri_beats: XAUT loan excludes Canada/EU at launch — Auri's temporary window
competitors.positioning: Auri's window is real but time-boxed. In Canada it's regulatory and temporary; in the US there may be no window — only a race.
competitors.watch: Tether×Ledn XAUT loan launch and its jurisdiction list. THE most urgent threat alongside Coinbase.

competitors.name: Coinbase
competitors.one_liner: Lends USDC against BTC from ~4% APR, built on Morpho, running on Base. The architectural distance to Auri is close to zero.
beats_auri: Already lending on Morpho at scale
auri_beats: Only lends against crypto, not gold
competitors.positioning: The differentiator vs Coinbase can't be rate — it's the collateral (gold) and the customer (savers). Also: Coinbase-on-Morpho validates Auri's rails.
competitors.watch: THE fastest-moving threat in the deck: Coinbase adds XAUT as collateral.

competitors.name: Nexo
competitors.one_liner: Crypto-backed credit lines on 100+ assets, 1.9-18.9% APR. Relaunched in the US in 2026 (excl. New York).
beats_auri: Breadth of assets, established, high limits
competitors.positioning: Everywhere in crypto lending — but never against gold.

competitors.name: Milo
competitors.one_liner: Crypto mortgages from 10.75% fixed — $100M+ originated, including a record $12M single loan.
competitors.positioning: Trained the market on borrow-don't-sell.

competitors.name: APX Lending
competitors.one_liner: Canadian crypto-backed loans — the direct Ledn competitor in Canada.
competitors.positioning: Crypto-collateral lender, not gold.

competitors.name: Morpho / Aave (direct DeFi)
competitors.one_liner: A sophisticated user can do exactly what Auri does, manually, for less — but ~99.9% of the target market never will.
competitors.positioning: Auri is the Web2 front door to the same rails.

competitors.name: Indian gold loans (Muthoot, Rupeek, IIFL)
competitors.one_liner: The mature, mass-market gold-loan industry — 8-15% APR. Auri at 3.75% is 2-4x cheaper than the entire Indian industry.
beats_auri: Massive scale, deep trust, physical branches
competitors.positioning: 2-4x cheaper than the entire Indian gold-loan industry — the diaspora knows exactly what a gold loan should cost.

competitors.name: Gnosis Pay
competitors.one_liner: Fully self-custodial Visa spending stablecoins from a Safe smart account — the architectural pattern Auri uses, on crypto.
auri_beats: No gold; not in Auri's launch markets; crypto-native brand
competitors.positioning: Architectural rival, not asset rival — they proved the pattern on crypto.
competitors.watch: If Gnosis Pay adds XAUT collateral, they get Auri's product overnight.

competitors.name: Ether.fi Cash
competitors.one_liner: Self-custodial Visa where you spend, borrow, OR earn against ETH/BTC/stablecoins — collateral still earns yield while you spend, 76 countries.
beats_auri: Spend+borrow+yield in one; yield while spending; 76 countries
competitors.positioning: Exactly Auri's architecture, on crypto not gold.

competitors.name: Wise / Remitly / Western Union
competitors.one_liner: Remittance incumbents. Auri doesn't beat them on price — it makes remittance a side effect of holding gold, and every gift-claim link a viral acquisition loop.
auri_beats: Remittance as a side effect of gold + viral gift loops
competitors.positioning: Absorb remittance as a growth loop, don't fight on price.
competitors.watch: IRS/Treasury guidance on the 1% excise applied to gold transfers.

competitors.name: India digital gold (Jar, SafeGold, MMTC-PAMP)
competitors.one_liner: 80M+ Indians already invest in digital gold — micro-savings into gold is validated at massive scale. Essential diaspora-GTM context.
competitors.positioning: Proves micro-savings-into-gold at scale; Auri adds everything they lack.
